storyCards.headline: Eminence Front: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Who's "Eminence Front" reached #68 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #68 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 6 weeks on the chart.

Eminence Front was released in 1982.
